content.comment_body: Hello everyone. I need to update [product_name] [product_name] [version_no] to the latest version provided by [company_name]. The computer is located in a village without internet access. Is there an alternative way to update the software without internet? Is it possible to update using a file, and where can I find this file? Can someone in the forum share this file? Otherwise, I will have to move the computer a long distance to access the internet. Thanks in advance. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], One way is to update via internet (direct file download and installation), and another is if you already have the files downloaded and saved to your PC. Refer to [url] for upgrades and updates. Download the required files and follow the instructions. Best regards, [user_name]

Hi, You can download the update file (Update File) to update using a file here: [url] You may send this file to your customer. To install: go to Help > Update Center, select the file option instead of internet, and browse to the folder containing the file. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for a way to update [product_name] [product_name] offline because internet access isn't available where the software is installed. Other forum members explain that the update can be performed using a downloadable update file and provide instructions for manual installation via file. The discussion underscores challenges with software maintenance in remote areas and emphasizes the importance of flexible offline update options.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to update [product_name] [product_name] without internet access on the destination computer, preferably by obtaining an installable update file directly from [company_name] or shared by community members.
